title: AI with your own key
intro: Answers, briefs and cuts use an AI provider you choose. Your key stays on this server and is never shown again.
not-connected: Not connected yet. Pick a provider, paste your key and choose a model.
about-openai: Paid. Strong models; you pay per use.
about-groq: Free tier, fast. A good place to start; long texts are sent in smaller parts.
about-openrouter: One key for many models from many companies.
about-ollama: Runs on your own computer. No key, nothing leaves your network.
about-custom: Any service with an OpenAI-compatible API.
from-env: Set on the server with {{name}} in .env.
key-replace: Paste a new key to replace it.
key-will-forget: The saved key will be removed when you save.
base-url-preset: Change it only if your provider told you to.
base-url-ollama: In Docker with the local-ai profile: http://ollama:11434/v1. Ollama on another computer: http://<its address>:11434/v1.
base-url-custom: Usually ends in /v1. Use https:// for anything outside your own network.
model-placeholder: Pick or type a model id
models-need-key: Paste your key to see the models.
models-need-address: Enter the address to see the models.
models-count_one: {{count}} model available. Pick it from the list.
models-count_other: {{count}} models available. Pick one from the list.
models-none: The provider listed no models. Type the model id.
limit-hint: Long transcripts are sent in parts of this size. Lower it if the provider says the text is too long.
limit-invalid: Use a whole number from 1,000 to 2,000,000.
transcription-on: On. Episodes without a transcript can get one.
transcription-off: Off. Episodes without a transcript can't get one yet.
transcription-how-on: PodFetch sends the downloaded episode to the service in TRANSCRIPTION_API_BASE_URL (set in .env).
transcription-how-off: To turn it on, set TRANSCRIPTION_API_BASE_URL, TRANSCRIPTION_API_KEY and TRANSCRIPTION_MODEL in .env (free with a Groq key), then restart the app.
ask-not-connected: AI answers are off. <settings>Connect AI in Settings → AI</settings>. You can still find and play source passages.
